Aseel joined the lab in March 2026 as a graduate student in the [Pathobiology
Graduate Program](https://pathobiology.biomed.brown.edu/). She is continuing the
lab's work on alanine transport in pulmonary fibrosis, and is developing methods
to measure the biomechanical properties of lung extracellular matrix. She
completed a master's degree at Brown, where she built organoid-derived monolayer
models to study host immune responses to *Candida* infection.
